description: Slice W8 of design/web-parity-plan.md. Look it up (Wikipedia): FIRST verify whether Wikipedia's API allows browser CORS requests (web_fetch/curl with Origin header). Network requests are a T8 change: write the design note and a draft DECISIONS entry marked waiting on parent, and DO NOT build the request code unless it can ship disabled behind that approval; if not buildable, mark the slice 'waiting on parent' in PROGRESS.md and plan table, commit docs only. Independent of later slices; depends on earlier ones only for existing code.
steps: Write design/look-it-up-w8.md (parent pre-approved the plan, 'go do it all'; list student-visible wording as awaiting parent okay) and run the AGENTS.md design review checklist
Put pure logic in js/logic/ with node tests incl. awkward cases; screen code in js/screens/ or existing screen files; save data only via js/storage.js
Add Playwright spec tests/browser/<slice>.spec.js: main path and awkward path (distracted, empty, refresh mid-step, damaged storage)
Add steps to tests/manual-checks.md; update PROGRESS.md and the slice table status in design/web-parity-plan.md
Self-review the diff against the AGENTS.md Stage 2 checklist, then run lint, logic tests and full browser suite via temp Chrome config (delete config after)
Commit only own files by name: git -c user.email=hagan@cih.com commit -m 'feat(web): ...'. If it cannot be finished, revert the slice and record why in PROGRESS.md
